chunks: Rifa'ah ibn Musa narrated from Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who has sons whose mother is not one; may he favor one of them over another? He said: “Yes, there is no harm in that, and my father عليه السلام used to favor me over 'Abd Allah.”

key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: 'Abd Allah, the person mentioned for comparison
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it

ai.seo_question: Can a father favor one son over another if they are from different mothers?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses whether a father may show preference among his sons when they are from different mothers. Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام states that there is no harm in this, and he cites the practice of his father عليه السلام as an example.
